intro: A perfect blend of charm and practicality, the Sketch bedside table, crafted from solid rubberwood, adds warmth and utility to your space—making every bedtime routine seamless.

features.title: Compact yet spacious design
features.text: Perfect for smaller spaces, it balances space-saving dimensions with ample storage, making it versatile and practical.

features.title: Solid wood for lasting durability
features.text: Made from premium rubberwood, it offers exceptional durability, resistance to fungus, and a long-lasting build.

features.title: Smart storage, always within reach
features.text: Features a drawer and an open shelf, offering organised space for bedside essentials and keeping everything within easy reach.

features.title: Smooth finish, timeless appeal
features.text: Dense grains and fine sanding create a superior, polished look that elevates its visual appeal.

features.title: Hassle-free maintenance
features.text: Resistant to bacteria and mold, it’s easy to clean and maintain, ensuring hassle-free ownership.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Sketch Solid Wood Bedside Table
